resources.string: Make your status bar yours with Wi-Fi and battery styles.
A cyan and violet energy ring with the live battery percentage when wired charging starts.
System tools and screen capture settings.
Allow screenshots and screen recordings of app windows that use FLAG_SECURE. Off by default. DRM-protected video may remain blank.
Select installed user apps that may accept updates signed with a different key. Only selected apps are affected; normal APK integrity checks remain on.
Allowing a differently signed update for %1$s lets the new version access this app's existing data. Select only trusted test APKs.
